map.由各组分的物质的量求摩尔分数: Mole fraction from the amount of substance of each component
map.输入两种或多种组分的物质的量，自动归一化为摩尔分数。: Enter the amount of substance of two or more components and it is normalized into mole fractions automatically.
map.📖 查看「由各组分的物质的量求摩尔分数 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding Mole Fraction from the Amount of Substance Usage Guide"
map.x_i = n_i / Σn_i，所有 x_i 之和为 1。 仅统计正数输入项。: x_i = n_i / Σn_i, and all x_i sum to 1. Only positive entries are counted.
map.x_i = n_i / Σn_i，所有 x_i 之和为 1。: x_i = n_i / Σn_i, and all x_i sum to 1.
map.📚 深度解析：由各组分的物质的量求摩尔分数: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding Mole Fraction from the Amount of Substance
map.二元溶液：由两组分摩尔算 x_A、x_B（和为 1）。: Binary solutions: get x_A and x_B from the moles of the two components (they sum to 1).
map.道尔顿分压：x_i 乘总压得组分分压。: Dalton partial pressure: multiply x_i by the total pressure to get the component partial pressure.
map.理想溶液活度近似：稀溶液用 x 近似活度。: Ideal solution activity approximation: in dilute solutions, use x to approximate activity.
map.输入 A 2 mol、B 3 mol，工具输出 x_A=0.40、x_B=0.6: Enter A = 2 mol and B = 3 mol, the tool outputs x_A = 0.40 and x_B = 0.60 and notes that all components sum to 1.
map.所有组分和为 1；不为 1 说明漏组分或算错。: All components sum to 1; if not, a component was missed or the arithmetic is wrong.
map.和体积分数一样吗？: Is it the same as volume fraction?
map.理想气体近似等，液体不等（分子体积差）。: Roughly equal for ideal gases, but not for liquids (molecular volumes differ).
map.多组分怎么算？: How do I handle more than two components?
map.分别 n_i/Σn，本质同二元推广。: Compute n_i / Σn for each; it is the same binary idea generalized.
